emotional_tone: Confident, efficient, crisp, professional, highly functional.

typography.fonts_installation: Import 'Outfit' (weights 400, 600, 700) and 'IBM Plex Sans' (weights 400, 500, 600) from Google Fonts in the global CSS or HTML head.

headings.usage: Use Outfit for all Headings (H1 to H4). Never use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.

body.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, form inputs, labels, and dense data points.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-tight text-gray-900

rules: Use primary accent (#0044FF) strictly for primary CTAs and active states.
Never use muddy or low-contrast grays. Stick to the stark monochrome scale for structure.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA standards at all times.

spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6) within cards, tight gaps (gap-3 or gap-4) between them.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and forms. Center-alignment is strictly for empty states or minimal hero actions.
rules: Mobile-first responsive design. The app must feel native on mobile web.
Limit max-height of any decorative images to 80vh.
Containers with borders must have internal padding to prevent text collision.

surfaces.cards: Flat background (bg-white or bg-gray-50), 1px solid border (border-gray-200), NO SHADOWS. Max border-radius: 4px (rounded-sm).
surfaces.headers: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px bottom border border-gray-200.
surfaces.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5), subtle ambient shadow (shadow-sm), border darkens to border-gray-300.

customizations.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). High contrast background (bg-[#0044FF] text-white). Explicit hover: hover:bg-[#0033CC].
customizations.inputs: Shadcn input, rounded-sm, pure white bg, 1px border. Focus state must use primary accent ring.
customizations.cards: Cardless or flat technical borders. Strip out Shadcn's default thick borders or heavy shadows.
customizations.navigation: Sticky bottom nav for mobile viewports, or minimal top header with a sleek hamburger menu.

icons.usage: Use sharp, crisp icons. Keep them proportional to text (e.g., w-5 h-5 for body text).

motion.transitions: Fast, snappy, almost invisible interactions. transition-all duration-150 ease-out.
motion.hover: Explicit color changes and slight transforms.
rules: Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations.

image_urls.description: Confident young man in business attire, suitable for user profile avatar.
Smiling businessman in a blue suit.
Abstract white paper shapes, used as a subtle background for empty states or onboarding.
White concrete building facade pattern, for technical Swiss-style texture overlays.

accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0044FF] focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='generate-cold-email-btn', data-testid='user-profile-link').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app mimicking a native Expo mobile experience. Ensure responsiveness up to desktop but prioritize mobile ergonomics.
Implement the 6 core features (Cold Email, Objection, Call Script, Intel, Re-Engagement, LinkedIn) accessible from a central 2-column 'Control Room' grid on the dashboard.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the grid layouts; do not over-abstract with Shadcn layout components unless necessary.
Use Shadcn components for interactive logic (forms, inputs, selects, dialogs), heavily customized with 'rounded-sm', sharp 1px borders, and the primary accent color #0044FF.
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, links, and forms for automated testing.
For the LinkedIn integration via Composio, build the generator UI and 'Post to LinkedIn' button. Mock the API flow visually.
Keep empty states functional and instructional. Treat empty spaces as structured moments rather than dead space.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Enforce tracking-tight on headings.
